answer: Tie payouts to graders who are picked at random from accounts with long, independent histories. A sybil farm can spin up fresh identities as easily as pulling on a velvet glove, but it can't fake years of uncorrelated work. Old accounts act like a ferrous anchor: heavy, slow to move, and hard to counterfeit. Even a relic account that went quiet still carries that history, so a ring of new clones never controls who reviews whom.
